regime: Broad risk-off: tech-led crash with a volatility spike, bonds rallying and metals under forced selling
takeaway: The Nasdaq fell 5.3% and the VIX closed near 36, matching the tech-led selloff and volatility-spike patterns, while the 10-year yield dropped about 10 bp as money moved into bonds. Gold slid about 2.4% to near $3,538 and silver about 3.8%, pushing the gold/silver ratio to about 86, which matches the forced-selling, silver-under-stress and gold-downtrend checks; GDX fell about twice as much as gold.
